title: Member Program Detail Page
description: Create an authenticated /account/programs/[slug] page that serves as a member's personal view of a program they're registered for or have access to. Replaces the current pattern where the dashboard links to the public marketing page. Should include: registration status, Zoom/join link, calendar links (Google/Apple), pending actions (complete dana, update info), program logistics (next session date/time, location). Future: announcements, materials, form updates, host info.
notes: Dashboard currently links to public /programs/[slug] which is awkward for registered members. This page would be the inside-the-building view vs the storefront window.

title: Facilitator Profile Links
description: Link facilitators on program detail pages to User records with photos and short bios. Currently facilitators are stored as String[] (plain text names) with no avatar or profile link. Requires: connecting facilitator names to User records, displaying teacher profile photos (60px circular), linking to public teacher profile pages where they exist.
notes: Old Webflow site had circular photos next to facilitator names. Data model change needed — may link to existing teacherProfile records.

title: Program dateText/timeText Data Cleanup
description: Some programs in the live database have empty dateText and timeText fields. The seed file has correct values for all 13 programs, but the live DB is out of sync. Without dateText, the community programs page shows specific dates (e.g. 'Tuesday, April 14') instead of recurring labels ('Mondays'). Fix: either re-run the seed (overwrites all program fields) or update dateText/timeText through the Program Editor for each program.
notes: Discovered during community programs page redesign (session 84). The buildSubtitle function works correctly — prefers dateText, appends time from datetime, appends format. Just needs the data populated.

title: Redesign Remaining Legacy Pages
description: ~15 pages still reference Webflow class names via the legacy shim. Each needs an individual design pass to replace Webflow classes with prefixed design-system classes. Priority: Donate, Volunteer, Community Membership, Login. Lower priority: Diversity, Kalyana Mitta, Glossary, Magazine Articles.
notes: Legacy shim at bottom of custom.css can be deleted once all pages are migrated. Homepage and community programs page are done (session 84).
